page.overview:
Who is Burgh?

Burgh is the Gym Leader at Castelia City's Castelia City Gym of the Unova region as well as an accomplished artist who speicializes in -types Pokémon. His gym is the third to be challenged by the player. He will award the player character the Insect Badge if defeated.

Burgh is a tall, thin young man, with bright green eyes and chin length, thick honey brown, wavy short hair. Burgh wears a cider green V neck shirt, with long sleeves, as well as a white undershirt. Burgh also wears a red scarf around his neck, a brown belt with a butterfly-design buckle, red pants with dark green and black vertical stripes, dark socks and flat pointy shoes matching his pants' color. Burgh also makes some poses, showing the world how a great artist he is.

A young artist in Castelia, Burgh attains a rather eccentric and artsy personality.

The name Burgh comes from "bug" and possibly the suffix "-burg" (city), as he lives in one of the biggest cities in Unova
